notes: The schematic image was not available; wiring is inferred from the sketch pin defines: D5 = white LED (meeting room), D2 = RGB red, D3 = RGB blue, D4 = RGB green, common cathode and white LED cathode to GND.
The 4 x 220 ohm resistors are one per LED channel (1 white, 3 RGB), each in series between the Arduino pin and the LED anode/colour lead.
Breadboard hole positions are my own layout choice; the manual doesn't give them. Resistors bridge the centre gap of the breadboard.

The MKR ENV Shield is stacked on top of the MKR WiFi 1010 and is used over I2C (SDA=D11, SCL=D12) plus power. It isn't in the catalogue, so a minimal new part type was added with only its power and I2C ports. Jumper wires are attached to the MKR board pins, which the shield passes through.
The Arduino Cloud and Alexa steps are software only and add no parts.
